meta.title: Familypedia (Demo)
meta.description: Create your own, private Wikipedia about your family. Pre-loaded with a historical Austrian family tree, the House of Habsburg from 1802 to 2011, so you can explore right away.
meta.author: Alex Kirk

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

if ( ! class_exists( '\Familypedia\Gedcom' ) || ! class_exists( '\Familypedia\Front_Page' ) || ! post_type_exists( \Familypedia\Person::POST_TYPE ) ) {
	return;
}

$demo_dir = WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/familypedia/demo';
$gedcom_file = $demo_dir . '/demo.ged';
if ( ! is_readable( $gedcom_file ) ) {
	return;
}

$importer = new \Familypedia\Gedcom();
$result   = $importer->import_string( file_get_contents( $gedcom_file ) );

if ( is_wp_error( $result ) || empty( $result['ids']['FRANZ_KARL'] ) ) {
	return;
}

$content_file = $demo_dir . '/demo-content.xml';
if ( is_readable( $content_file ) ) {
	$importer->apply_content_string( file_get_contents( $content_file ), true );
}

\Familypedia\Front_Page::add_trees( array( $result['ids']['FRANZ_KARL'] ) );
